headline.lead: AI tools pick Klaviyo in 24 of 40 answers. Two of the four reasons they give are out of date. Address these first on the comparison page.

points.text: Klaviyo is picked in 24 of 40 answers, GetResponse in 11.
“Klaviyo has deeper e-commerce automation and reporting” mostly comes from training data, not live search.
Price is the strength every engine already agrees on.

priority.reason: Highest store need and the biggest gap. AI repeats a weakness the live check says is out of date, so this is the first thing the page must correct.
Same pattern as #1: most answers predate the feature. Correcting it needs a clear proof point on the page.
A strength AI already agrees on, with top store need. Keep it high, but it shifts fewer answers than #1 and #2.
A real gap with high need. Cover it honestly (what syncs today) after the strengths, without claiming parity.
Medium need and no settled view. One setup-time proof point could tip it.
A real gap with medium need. Mention it briefly, don't lead with it.

priority.feature: Landing pages, webinars and courses in one plan
priority.reason: A true strength, but low need for most stores. Cover it last.
